data.title: 2 Euros (Constantine and Methodius)

composition.text:
Bimetallico: centro in nickel
 rivestito di ottone al nichel con anello in rame-nichel

obverse.description: (en) Inner part: mid-length facing nimbate busts of Saint Constaintine (left) holding book with both hands, and Saint Methodius (right) holding patriarchal cross planted in the middle of three small hills with his right hand, and model of a church in his left. Designer's initials at left, and mint mark at right.

reverse.description: Europa a destra accanto al valore

data.commemorated_topic: 1150° anniversario dell'avvento della missione di Costantino e Metodio nella Grande Moravia
data.comments:
(en)

Additional comments on the obverse symbolism:

The cross is moreover held like a Bishop’s crozier, thereby bringing together the symbols of statehood and Christianity, and emphasising the significance of the brothers’ mission, which helped ensure the full sovereignty and legitimacy of Great Moravia — the first Slav state in central Europe. The figure of Constantine is holding a book that represents education and faith, while Methodius is shown with a church to symbolise faith and institutional Christianity.
